title: Luxury Hotel Lobby Aquarium
description: We built a 30 foot aquarium with tropical fish, live coral and automated life support systems.

title: Island Resort Underwater Lounge
description: We built a glass underwater lounge with panoramic marine views and acoustic insulation. The glass also helps limit outside noise for guests.

title: Private Residence Aquascape
description: We built a freshwater aquascape with rare plants, driftwood and custom LED sunrise lighting.

title: Penthouse Built-in Reef Tank
description: We installed a modern saltwater tank in a penthouse wall to suit the interior.

title: Corporate HQ Atrium Waterfall
description: We built a multi story indoor waterfall and living plant wall for a calm workplace.

title: Executive Boardroom Aquascape
description: We installed a custom planted aquascape for a calm setting during executive meetings.

title: Tech Campus Central Feature Tank
description: A simple, modern aquarium for providing a natural mental respite for staff. The massive filtration system was hidden behind special acoustic panels, ensuring a completely silent workspace, despite crystal-clear water.

title: Zen Garden Japanese Koi Pond
description: A natural waterfall that creates a low noise level in the neighborhood, hidden bio-filtration, and hand-placed stepping stones make for a traditional outdoor koi habitat. The plumbing is completely concealed and hidden to maintain the aesthetic and clarity of the water for the imported fish all year round.

title: Modern Courtyard Reflecting Koi Pond
description: Architectural, geometric pond with structure built of glass experience walls, floating concrete walkways and integrated smart lighting. Guests will be able to see the fishes from below the water surface, and this will make the fish a focal point of the courtyard and the whole event, transforming the typical corporate courtyard into an interactive area.

title: City Botanical Garden Paludarium
description: A tremendous public exhibition that merges land and water. It is an area of dense rainforest vegetation, submerged mosses and native Amazonian fish. We designed an automatic misting system to maintain a stable humidity level in the enclosure, so that the land-dwelling orchids are as healthy as the aquatic plants that live below them.

title: Sky Lounge Infinity Water Cascade
description: A personalized roof top cascade that cascades into the view of the downtown cityscape. The basin was constructed of lightweight fiberglass composites and fitted with a wind sensing pump system to prevent any splash out due to high winds and strict structural weight restrictions.
